programme.title: 模範家庭 #1
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: The Ones You Didnt Burn
programme.desc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今

programme.title: 凌晨兩點半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。

programme.title: 狄仁傑之詭鎮幽魂
programme.desc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密

programme.title: 千門八將
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述,正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次,他在與“賭魔”的賭局中,被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後,賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇,正將被賭魔以千術擊敗,含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇,邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博

programme.title: 弟子也瘋狂
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官與胡惠乾三位俗家弟子初入少林,拜於南院戒嗔大師門下習武。然而,三人常與出家弟子悟清較勁切磋,寺中從此喧嚷不絕,連方丈見此情景亦不免啼笑皆非。

programme.title: 請帖
programme.desc: 青年俠士辛酸得悉王爺擬委託四大殺手押送神秘箱子往西安,且將付出十萬兩銀子作酬金,辛遂殺四人及持其頭顱往見王爺,求接辦保鏢事,蓋辛欲得該筆巨額酬金作賑災之用,王爺允之。辛途遇妙手怪丐楊風、無形劍客古非天及美豔女俠水仙花等高手截劫。原來當中牽涉通敵叛國的陰謀

programme.title: 血手印
programme.desc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁的女兒訂親,但富翁卻因肇德家道中落,反對婚事。肇德為迎娶其女兒,決定要上京考取功名。上京赴考前,肇德去見未婚妻,怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上,他更被誣陷殺人。究竟包公最後如何為他洗脫冤情?

programme.title: 孔雀王朝
programme.desc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王,正值莊內嚴肅之際,其未婚妻竟無理取鬧,沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後,二人繼續追捕歡喜王,但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。

programme.title: 死囚
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪,遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口,賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的,於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗,最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。

programme.title: 西遊記
programme.desc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。

programme.title: 小子有種
programme.desc: 貪官為討好一群西方人,設計攫取鎮中廟宇的寶貴佛像。幸得張德泰醫師及其兒子張小泰二人合力利用中國功夫,先破西洋拳,再敗日本劍道,然後大勝西洋劍,最終才可保住佛像。

programme.title: 醜聞
programme.desc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。

programme.title: 惡虎村
programme.desc: 九姑娘之兄巴傑勾結惡虎村惡霸胡蛟,圖劫鏢銀,被「鐵沙掌」駱宏勛打傷。胡蛟恐事發後被巴家追究,下毒將巴傑毒斃,嫁禍駱宏勛,巴家上下誓欲殺死駱報仇……

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。

programme.title: 蕭十一郎
programme.desc: 蕭十一郎被人冒名作惡,送割鹿刀托連城璧殺蕭。寶刀途中被軒轅無敵奪去。軒欲強搶美女沈璧君,蕭英雄救美。蕭行蹤敗露,被連伏擊重傷,幸為沈所救。蕭決意將寶刀取回

programme.title: 北地胭脂
programme.desc: 本片由三個發生在妓院「百花樓」的單元故事組成。〈花街柳巷〉講述妓女大琴不甘淪落為娼,竟冒險向巡官告狀,要求救她脫離火坑;〈滿宮春色〉講述同治皇帝大婚之前,往妓院尋歡,終於染上梅毒不治;〈游龍豔史〉講述正德皇帝與名妓佛動心同入鴛帳

programme.title: 南斗官三鬥北少爺
programme.desc: 廣東大良富家子斗官學得一身功夫,在鄉間常闖禍;其母希望斗官娶妻立品,乃遣其上京參加香格格招親大會。其實斗官所以答允上京,目的是找名傳京城的三名北少爺-「千術北少爺」車載、泡妞高手「真厲害」和「神偷北少爺」時三手一較高下。四人不打不相識,最後更成為好友,合力對付仇家三眼道人

programme.title: 南斗官三鬥北少爺
programme.desc: 廣東大良富家子斗官學得一身功夫,在鄉間常闖禍;其母希望斗官娶妻立品,乃遣其上京參加香格格招親大會。其實斗官所以答允上京,目的是找名傳京城的三名北少爺-「千術北少爺」車載、泡妞高手「真厲害」和「神偷北少爺」時三手一較高下。四人不打不相識,最後更成為好友,合力對付仇家三眼道人

programme.title: 神劍震江湖
programme.desc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」,以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎,兩人情投意合。可惜,當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後,事情也開始變得越來越複雜。

programme.title: 怒海情仇
programme.desc: 故事描述,青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好;土豪獨子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,時藉故親近;一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂,金虎抱不平,幾動武,惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係…

programme.title: 大刀王五
programme.desc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同,這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法,但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權,因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場,卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。

programme.title: 青春1000日
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃,由當舞女之姊撫養成長,方則出身富家,受母呵護備至。畢業後,凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍,方則滿足於平淡生活中;但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生,改寫了他們三人的一生…

programme.title: 大決鬥
programme.desc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後,唐人杰毅然承擔罪責,成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下,他終於成功復仇,卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。

programme.title: 千王鬥千霸
programme.desc: 名震賭壇的千王與其拍檔受命調查一位上海賭界大亨,懷疑其以賭場為掩護從事間諜活動。兩人深入危機四伏的賭局世界,在層層布局與試探中步步為營,與強敵展開一場關乎生死與榮耀的鬥智對決。

programme.title: 背叛師門
programme.desc: 高堅是武林大豪石正仲門下小弟子,但因石正仲性格偏執,常不問是非情由就對高堅施以懲罰。一次,高救了師父的仇人金天運,金為報恩將武功授給高,高卻被判「背叛師門」之罪

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。

programme.title: 少林傳人
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位,率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮;皇帝見大勢已去,命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下,大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養,法號道行,習得少林絕技;二太子則易名五子泰,由丞相撫養。多年後,五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」,與道行相遇,卻不知對方正是親兄弟……

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?

programme.title: 毒龍潭
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙,盜去師父的玉龍劍,並生下一子一女;後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭,唐抱子虞江逃走,女青兒則歸師公門下;二十年後,劍再次被盜,青女扮男裝,私下尋劍,卻遇樊舊友天涯客

programme.title: 風花雪月
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路

programme.title: 裸血
programme.desc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠,均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染,孟藉此勒索二人;後孟被殺,高成嫌疑犯,另孟之兄翟諾,亦向高勒索;而淩在家,也接見了穀峰,他聲言有為高洗罪的證據,但要索錢;王妻李香君借貸給淩 究竟誰是殺孟真凶?

programme.title: 邪
programme.desc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英

programme.title: 邪
programme.desc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英

programme.title: 武則天
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。

programme.title: 卒仔抽車
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子,遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成,達成了一個賭局,要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力,終戰勝億萬富豪!

programme.title: 不了情
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中,夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南,兩人漸生情愫,卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時,青青卻得知一個噩耗,最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。

programme.title: 明月刀雪夜殲仇
programme.desc: 改編自古龍原著小說,講述「天下第一快刀」傅紅雪為報父仇,萬里尋凶;期間墮入七名兇手布下之圈套,處境岌岌可危

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙

programme.title: 龍虎會風雲
programme.desc: 故事描述,金兵侵入,身負重傷的未國將軍囑其女、羅烈及張佩山飾的的愛徒,保護太上皇玉璽,不斷出計,最終難免決一死戰

programme.title: 乾隆下揚州
programme.desc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡,這次得大臣和大學士陪行,他們一行三人來到揚州,期間遇上不少趣事。

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位,令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客,最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位?

programme.title: 玫瑰我愛你
programme.desc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。

programme.title: 流氓千王
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王,李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後,遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥,出千騙財,開設豪華賭場,欲將陳誘得入局…

programme.title: 勾魂降頭
programme.desc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…

programme.title: 大俠沈勝衣
programme.desc: 武林中人對白家珍藏的「唐門火冊」虎視眈眈,後更揚言要擄劫其女。大俠沈勝衣於是建議以其情人煙飛代白家小姐,並尋出個中玄機

programme.title: 港澳傳奇
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆,識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後,威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻;香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人,事後恬要求與石同居,結局出人意表

programme.title: 決殺令
programme.desc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和,以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派,但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼?最終又能否揭開真相?

programme.title: 嘿,楊先生
programme.desc: 晴空萬里,豔陽高照,繁華的都市中,快遞小車在擁堵的街道上敏捷地穿行著。網路時代的今天,快遞小哥們已經成為了這座城市不可取代的一部分了,楊旦就是他們中的一員。n從小城市來的楊旦滿懷鬥志地開著快遞車在城市中派送著各式各樣的快遞物品,突然的,一間

programme.title: 女神捕之現形
programme.desc: 江南尋花會誘騙婦女作惡多端,為官場和坊間所深惡痛絕。為剷除江南尋花會犯罪團夥,朝廷頒旨,由刑部侍郎張文台主持,蘇州趙敬軒大人協助,著都察院派出鐵飛花秘查此案限期破獲。鐵飛花領旨離京。啟程前,鐵飛花求助於江湖朋友“老迷糊,請“老迷糊協助調

programme.title: 預備奶爸
programme.desc: 海歸青年周宇飛帶著在國外意外懷孕的妻子姚倩倩一起返回北京家中,費盡心計,終於使父親、岳母和妻子答應了他留下孩子的請求,並承諾孩子出生後,由其照顧,讓姚倩倩安心複習功課,回國外複讀。n這件事剛剛平息,周宇飛陷入了新的夾板氣:父親是老腦筋,認為

programme.title: 焦裕祿
programme.desc: 該片描寫了縣委書記--焦裕祿同志,在蘭考縣任職期間,抱重病帶領全縣人民群眾戰天鬥地,克己奉公,甘當人民公僕,為改變蘭考面貌,為黨的事業謳心瀝血,鞠躬盡瘁的動人故事。

programme.title: 領袖·1935
programme.desc: 一九三五年初,當日本帝國主義侵佔華北,民族矛盾集聚上升之時,中國共產黨領導的紅軍被國民黨蔣介石幾十萬軍隊的圍追堵截。 遵義會議過後,黨中央北上土城,準備從宜賓渡過長江的時候,一場遭遇戰,令中央紅軍陷入困境。這是毛澤東回到黨中央領導地位後指揮

programme.title: 奪魂異陣圖
programme.desc: 五代十國,龐存義為救恩人小茉季,與結拜兄弟一起趕赴南唐,結果捲入奪取火藥坑地圖的陰謀中,先被困幽冥山谷,再失去兩位結拜兄弟,最終龐存義卻發現一切都是兩兄弟設計的圈套。龐存義最終為正義而戰,奪回了地圖。

programme.title: 刑警張玉貴的隊長生活
programme.desc: 刑警隊長張玉貴為避嫌,向上級請求把妻子付明明調到別的派出所工作,付明明不幹,二人有了摩擦,恰在這時,隊裡接手了一個殺人案。殺人嫌疑犯竟然是被殺者的丈夫,經偵查,證據幾乎屬實並結案,但張玉貴卻感到有些問題不妥,付明明理解張玉貴並全力幫助他偵破

programme.title: 國寶險途
programme.desc: 影片講述了八路軍戰士在日寇的圍追堵截中迂回避險,並與潛伏特務鬥智鬥勇最終成功保衛了國寶級經卷的故事。

programme.title: 愛情的代駕
programme.desc: 一部講述事業愛情雙失意的大齡單身奶爸鐘成奎為實現人生反轉,為神秘富二代當職業愛情替身,結果遭遇多重意外驚喜的爆笑愛情喜劇故事。

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #1

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #3
programme.desc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與鱷魚爭奪河流的主導權,展開對支配權的激烈較量,然後一瞥極為罕見的紅樹林蛇,以及瀕臨絕種的納巴勒克小袋鼠前往海洋,看見座頭鯨的母鯨撫育牠們的幼鯨,接著又遭到偽虎鯨的追逐與獵捕

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #1

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #4

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Early morning at the Brash household and Dr Matt and his wife Clare, a horse vet, with their children enjoy a traditional English breakfast - on a traditional Dales day They're off to the Malton Show It's been an annual event for over a century, a chance for local people to meet and compete for prizes with their finest produce In a rural community, vets are crucial Matt started as a farm vet before specialising in exotic animals The show also gives him an opportunity to keep in touch with livestock

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-有一種體驗叫終生美麗
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 屬靈教室:葉劍華牧師-喜樂的人生
programme.desc: 在腓立比書出現了12次「喜樂」,是新約中出現最多「喜樂」的書卷。基督教樂恩堂堂主任葉劍華牧師,就會從腓立比書教導觀眾如何在困難中、服事中活出喜樂,並且將喜樂帶給身邊的人。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:一個義人的畫像 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 程蒙恩長老-主耶穌的「喜怒哀樂」
programme.desc: 究竟我們可以怎樣在生活和事奉裡討主的喜悅?論到《聖經》四福音書,記載了不少耳熟能詳關於耶穌的生平事蹟。程蒙恩長老提醒我們,可以從這些記載看到主耶穌喜歡什麼,我們學習喜歡主耶穌所歡喜的事物,就可以討主喜悅。

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#121粵
programme.desc: 大業主兒子威少到藥房宣布全商場即將加租三成，眾人發起反加租抗議行動。威少無故斷水斷電，誓要令慶屈服，慶邀請威少欣賞由高家扮演之街頭劇，威少因怯於記者窮追猛打，私下欲與高慶講和，慶卻當眾撕毀藥房租約。

programme.title: 夢華錄#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 盼兒知道了蕭欽言就是害自己淪入賤籍的元兇，但並無為此遷怒千帆，反而逼千帆正視自己內心，二人又重新言歸於好。皇帝不相信夜宴圖是真品，繼續寵信皇后，歐陽旭也因而被貶至新州，令他大受打擊。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽以77元煮出滋補四式為孕婦進補，更為了令有補血作用的黃鱔飯煮出飯焦，出動秘密武器。益母草有活血去瘀的功效，有助婦女產後調理，肥媽以此煮出滋潤甜品。「大廚平煮」，麥潔兒教授平價的蠔仔京蔥千層麵。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不少人未必清楚「日落症候群」與「譫妄」的分別，精神科醫生解釋，前者是通常在下午至傍晚出現的行為及精神症狀，譫妄則屬急性發作的意識及認知紊亂。醫生指兩者皆與認知障礙症相關，並帶來成因與診治資訊。皮膚科醫生指出，疣是由人類乳頭狀病毒(HPV)引起的疾病，並細說常見疣的類別。他強調生疣與否主要視乎個人免疫力及皮膚狀況，另外也會講解珍珠疣及皰疹的相關資訊。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「香蒜牛油煎鮑魚」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 用汽球密封水杯，即使倒轉，水亦不會流出？第一條動作題就要進行相關考驗，有藝人臨陣手忙腳亂，不慎打翻水杯！另外，怎樣利用膠水瓶、地拖棍等物品，在伸手不及的高度換燈泡？開展從雪櫃找答案的比拼前，靖韻自言對下廚有信心，最拿手煮「可樂雞翼」，題目卻是關於去除魚腥……搶答回合，問起「FSC認證」會在甚麼材質製成的傢俱上出現？麗珊原來曾修讀環保學科，能否憑相關知識得分？五題過後，某藝人隊暫時竟領先逾千五分！

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#3粵PG
programme.desc: 明翔槍擊譚彬，製造混亂助他離去。江揚以明翔獨特的香水味，查知她對槍械有深厚認識。譚彬在超市巧遇保安主任江翹，江翹請他出讓公仔被拒，糾纏間譚彬不慎毀壞江翹的絕版公仔。江揚發覺明翔乍作不認識喜善妻子陸定虹，查得喜善是集團車手。江翹揭破譚彬以假公仔還給她，譚彬到江翹家偷公仔，發現江揚鎖定明翔及喜善為目標人物。美莉見蓉蓉穿著睡衣在餐廳出入，疑高哲和蓉蓉拍拖，建議江揚偷看高哲的PDA，但被高哲揭發。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 最初，環保玩具設計師只希望改變孩子貪新棄舊的買玩具惡性循環，因而開展以廢物改造成玩具的設計之路。他回憶首個成品是以鞋盒製成停車場，原意是培養孩子收納玩具的習慣，卻意外啟發孩子自行添加設計，演變成完整的城市場景。設計師亮相節目，展示多款自製環保玩具，包括彈珠機、夏威夷小結他、電動玩具車等，並逐一介紹箇中設計巧思。他強調每件成品都經歷無數次失敗，才可誕生，其中一款遊戲機更花了兩年時間反覆嘗試方能完成。

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 蜻蛉與五十一回到火之島，兩人一邊坐在長凳上看夕陽，一邊回顧出島後的種種，蜻蛉去到熊本升學，在有働家寄宿，參加九州女子錦標賽，跟圓、檜和艾瑪競爭最後一刻，體會到何謂真正的高爾夫球。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 食平D粵

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#4粵PG

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#4粵
programme.desc: 風切變猛然吹襲跑道，駕駛貨機的啟光與可兒於危急關頭堅持降落，引發航空公司高層啟動「事故調查」，啟光面臨停飛處分。雅雯身為調查小組成員，手上一票足以左右啟光的飛行生涯，啟光卻作出一個令人始料未及的決定……網紅章妙妙為了流量，購買機票後故意錯過航班，發起「機場禁區留宿三日」的挑戰，陳杰帶領團隊透過直播互動與監控追蹤展開搜索……杜拜機場發生嚴重倒塌事故，尚偉未能聯絡身在當地的前妻張若玲，頓時陷入慌亂……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 沿着尼羅河，兩主持乘船抵達阿斯旺的菲萊神殿。這裡正是公元前47年，埃及妖后舉行尼羅河巡遊的終點。二人透過AI技術參與當時盛況，並嘗試探究埃及妖后的死亡之謎。繼續順流而上，來到努比亞人聚居的村莊。翠如體驗手搖織布機，卻一開始便失手！法老拉美西斯二世為古埃及建造了不少宏偉建築，阿布辛貝神殿也是其一。主持們以科技化身「神的使者」一探「太陽奇蹟」，又意外帶領這位法老「穿越」時空，見證神殿遷移的歷史時刻。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞協助調查八姨娘死因，發現屍體被移動過，燕遲查出是秦老夫人為掩蓋醜聞所為，二人推測熟人作案。八姨娘疑患楊梅瘡，燕遲要對秦府所有男丁驗身，結果在紫竹林枯井內發現八姨娘的情夫劉春屍體，死因與八姨娘相同。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
獵鷹#2粵
programme.desc: 嘉琦在體能測驗時受傷，被振堂處罰。振堂指以嘉琦的成績必須嚴加訓練，大偉決心訓練喜琦。嘉琦與大偉一起返家，見家居被弄至烏煙瘴氣，教訓弟妹一頓，大偉欽佩嘉琦對弟妹的關懷。國基與蓮達等人在學堂酒吧內胡鬧，要大偉帶嘉琦同來，在場人等起哄，令嘉琦尷尬一怒而去。大偉生日，江霞囑約同學吃飯歡聚，大偉欲藉機與嘉琦修好，但嘉琦仍未息怒。振堂讓嘉琦參加野外領導訓練營，但其成績強差人意，嘉琦無奈向振堂提出調職。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 囤積症是一種精神健康疾病，患者心理上難以捨棄所積存的物件，引致情緒困擾，亦造成環境安全危機。精神科醫生講述箇中成因，並提到與性格有關。醫生提醒若替患者私自執拾，隨時「得不償失」，此話何解？法律援助服務，是確保合資格人士不會因欠缺經濟能力而沒法尋求公義，法援律師細說民事與刑事案件的法援涵蓋範圍。申請人要通過資產及案情審查才會獲批援助，但原來並非絕對免費？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「素擔擔涼拌茭白筍」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 繼續搶答題，許靖韻和艾妮隊接連答對，能否殺入最終回合？終極一對一，雙方先平分十個藏有不同金額的寶箱，共四萬元。每題發問前，兩隊要揀出對家的寶箱作為注碼，而先有答題權的隊伍可選擇作答，或由對方去答，答中即搶走對手的寶箱，直至問畢五題，兩隊各得的總獎金才會揭盅！最後一題關於電線接駁，牽涉六個寶箱的歸屬權，某隊竟將答題權給予對家；森美提醒另一隊內有男成員，或對相關知識較熟悉，可會同時將終極勝利送給對方？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#4粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚調查昔日師傅殉職的銀行劫案，初步認為高哲是兇手。譚彬還不出公仔，欲扮舊病復發撒賴，被江翹揭破；最後譚彬助江翹修復公司電腦保安系統，兩人冰釋前嫌。江揚從喜善留給明翔的假電話號碼中，找出盜賊犯案時間和地點。蓉蓉到美莉工作的銀行見工，得美莉相才獲得取錄。江揚以為明翔及喜善打算安排「黑吃黑」劫案，欲一網打盡，發覺在場的「賊人」統統都是內地高官！原來高哲擺下這個局，希望令江揚被投閒置散。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#122粵
programme.desc: 慶當眾撕毀藥房的租約，認為公義站在他身旁，喜指責慶苦了家人，因慶竟將藥房的貨物囤積在家。慶不知錯，反在家中「開業」，令高家上下苦不堪言。喜為阻事態惡化，要藥房伙計假裝辭職，再命高麗詐傷，迫慶另覓舖位。

programme.title: 夢華錄#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 盼兒和千帆路過大橋時，有人故意放了一捆木頭想砸傷他們，千帆以身護著盼兒被木頭砸傷。有人誣衊永安樓送的螃蟹變壞，引章和三娘帶著醫官到現場，證明被人栽贓嫁禍。官家認為千帆偽造夜宴圖，派張允把他帶回去審查。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 原宿色彩繽紛的餐廳，設立目的只為了一位名人？三藩市某餐廳每半小時「天降異象」，令人大驚！韓國集三款口味的長薄餅，可以有多長？楊明、葉翠翠、陳庭欣、黃子恆進行一番運氣大戰，「命水夠好」便能享用法國鵝肝！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥有餐廳不提供任何餐具，如何盛載食物？經常變形的海腸，應如何處理才可以食用？東京有餐廳以五盅食物作為鎮店之寶，究竟是甚麼平凡食材？Do姐與馬蹄露、袁偉豪及農夫一起憑錦囊猜題，竟顯示出她的高智慧！

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 除了龍舟競渡，不少與端午節有關的儀式習俗亦被列入非物質文化遺產之中。造船師傅羅土允有豐富的製作龍舟經驗，當中製作船頭船尾最為困難，難在哪裏？為祈求賽事順利，傳統於農曆五月初一凌晨要為龍舟進行開光及下水儀式，但龍舟沒法屈膝，它如何向神明叩拜？龍舟競渡是最廣為人知的傳統習俗，但「遊夜龍」又是甚麼？節目隨鍾氏頴川堂宗親會參加鮮為人知的遊夜龍，原來簡單如清潔神像、請神等，時間亦不由人決定！

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 除夕夜，鼎爺炮製足以令人飽肚的「裹蒸糉」，選葉選料都特別有要求，還要好好學習如何紮糭，以及預備整天為五花腩醃味。吃過糭，阿譚憶起端午節到順德古朗村跟村民一起包糉，並參與起龍儀式與千人龍船飯的熱鬧情況！香港地方細，絕少本土走地雞，但仍有自家培養雞種。鼎爺分享揀靚雞秘訣之餘，還切好薑絲、蔥絲，做出一碟「蔥油少爺雞」，甚麼方法可令雞皮更爽脆？鼎爺再煮一道「麻婆豆腐」滿足阿譚的食慾，但桌面竟見脢頭牛肉？

programme.title: 高朋滿座#123粵
programme.desc: 藥房自搬新舖後生意額大升，眾人被迫來幫忙。慶卻一於少理，四出遊玩，留信要溢及義到長洲去探三妗婆。惡女搶去溢滿與有義的月餅，他們卻發現惡女是三妗婆女兒蘇花，蘇花當眾欺負三妗婆，激得溢滿接三妗婆回家暫住。

programme.title: 2026 沙田龍舟競賽直播粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 2026年「沙田龍舟競賽」於端午節(6月19日星期五)舉行，節目緊貼在城門河賽道上的連場激烈比拼！

programme.title: 滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如體內的止餓荷爾蒙出現失衡，會令飽足訊號減弱，造成「食極唔飽」的假象。如長期失衡，不僅可能導致肥胖，更會增加糖尿病、慢性炎症及心血管疾病風險。內分泌及糖尿科醫生詳述診治方法，並建議透過飲食與運動着手改善。肩袖肌腱病屬退化性疾病，常見於長期勞損或年長人士。運動治療師細說此病的症狀，並指出它與五十肩的分別。嘉賓除了帶來治療資訊外，更引領主持做防治運動。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅帶來「馬拉盞雞球」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 不少中風病人並非長者，主持洪永城走訪年輕中風康復者凱琪，她於廿八歲時曾因中風被診斷為永久傷殘，如何一步步踏上復康之路？頭痛、頭暈、心律不正，都有可能是中風先兆。神經外科醫生黃秉康亦指，必先分清缺血性或出血性中風，因二者的治療方向完全不同，還要記得口訣「談笑用兵」。心房顫動是中風的一大誘因，心臟科醫生馮永康講解新式脈衝場消融術的治療原理。有大學研發出復康機械臂幫助中風患者，永城親身一試鍛練手指關節。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚和高哲鬥單車險墮崖，高哲相救。高哲回憶起自己為何做俠盜：廿五年前高哲父母因火災喪生，後他知道是富商趙經琛為收樓刻意放火，於是以其兒子君豪的安全為要脅，令經琛覺悟成為大慈善家，他自此覺得公義要靠自己爭取。高哲送外賣到會，遇上江揚及一班歡送他的同事，大海宣布江揚很快就可以回歸重案組。英杰想賣血鑽給君豪，要求蓉蓉陪波子去珠海動物園，想利用她偷運血鑽；英杰送蓉蓉回家，高哲問長問短，蓉蓉對他的用意起疑。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子問媽媽的寶物是什麼，後者拿出年輕時買的蛋白石指環，並透露已經由3萬升值至100萬。小玉和藤木來到小丸子家看指環，然後用指環玩遊戲，此時媽媽突然回家，一陣混亂過後，指環不知所蹤。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 父親節臨近，本集「Artspiration」以「與爸爸相處的時光」為主題作畫。繪畫人像需要不少技巧，子健哥哥示範從頭髮下筆。Emily姐姐擔心畫出來的人物身體比例會出現偏差，子健哥哥有何建議？由小朋友投稿分享的「開心SHARE」環節，這回主題是「我最想感謝的人」。Emily姐姐回憶兒時隨母親學跳舞，感激媽媽不斷鼓勵。玲玲姐姐感激姊姊對她的細心照顧，甚至因姊姊比她年長十五歲，曾讓旁人誤會二人是母女。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 敵方的新型邪音魔實力強橫，公主要出盡九牛二虎之力方能成功擊退。此仗令小源等人感到實力不足，在流星建議下，三人展開了合唱的特訓。然而，在特訓過程中，小源開始感到自身實力不足，拖累隊伍。

programme.title: 香港原味道粵
programme.desc: 譚玉瑛第四次領軍，帶着黃庭鋒、吳幸美、孔德賢、林正峰，還有新主持謝東閔及來自台灣的劉子碩，深入土炮食材的產地，尋找來自本港或香港製造的優質食材；亦體驗網購、外送美食新潮流。深入本地菜園、魚排、鮮果園、養雞場、茶園、食品廠、醬油廠等等，見證本地農業、漁業的發展，認識地道食材，發掘更多本地飲食智慧，品嚐每一口新鮮美味，探索每一種港產食材背後的故事。新環節「種出原味道」由庭鋒打理農田，親手種有機菜！

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 鴨脷洲一個海景四房單位，融入酒店風格，並以較深顏色，突顯型格感覺，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 香港大學：引領•無限粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2833粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 樹根意外發現垃圾袋內有一支顯示兩條線的驗孕棒，懷疑家中有人懷孕；也因對方未想公佈喜訊，他遂不便公開查問。根據種種線索，樹根先排除若水與尚善，轉而懷疑栢菲有孕，並與虹豆沙湯遠暗中查探，結果證實栢菲並未懷孕。近日在熊家出現的女子似乎都無可疑，惟樹根此時從龔燁口中得知曾有女子找城安並發生爭執，懷疑該人懷有城安的骨肉，城安卻不「認賬」。樹根查探後相信屬實，要求城安負上責任……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#5粵
programme.desc: 張穎、成軒在海天中轉大樓遇到疑於船上遺失護照的轉機旅客，二人憑藉有限線索，爭分奪秒於客船返航前展開搜索……颱風逼近，機場緊急啟動應變機制，尚偉、陳杰、勝祥都嚴陣以待。日飛偶然發現因航班取消而滯留的管弦樂團，發起一場即興音樂會。樂曲在接機大堂響起，成為颱風夜最動人的風景。啟光擔任「見習機師培訓課程」導師，對為生計奔波而遲到的學員徐安樂極之嚴苛，似要將安樂踢出學院……可兒於健身房鍛練時突感胸悶不適……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 屹立千年的羅馬鬥獸場，記載了古羅馬帝國輝煌、殘酷一頁。兩主持「穿越」投入鬥獸場開幕盛典，體會角鬥士與猛獸混戰、模擬海戰廝殺的熱血沸騰感。拆解皇帝不同手勢的迷思，手指公向上代表「處決」？現今也有角鬥士體驗學校，二人接受特訓，與「小鬥士」展開搏鬥，永城竟出賣拍檔？文藝復興三傑之首米高安哲羅當年將廢墟注入活力，以幾何元素打造建築神作，「回到過去」細看大師級美學。主持們亦一嚐傳統生乳包，卻搞怪「玩忌廉」？

programme.title: 女法醫解密#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 紫竹林井內挖出頭骨，秦老夫人指認是楊氏遺骸，秦莞驗骨發現少女骨頭，燕遲下令再探查井底，找到許多少女遺骸；據秦隸憶述往事和查出楊氏來歷，推測楊氏被秦安以女兒要脅進府，花棚井下或有骸骨，燕遲命人挖花棚井…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
獵鷹#3粵
programme.desc: 大偉為嘉琦調職之事找振堂理論，並憤而辭職，不被批准。江霞知大偉仍深愛警隊工作，遂與振堂會面，對振堂印象甚佳，勸大偉留在學堂。振堂認識大偉生父戚幹，答應介紹與他，但大偉於相約之日卻猶豫不決。原來江霞年輕時被迫出賣肉體，與戚幹發生關係後懷孕，迫於往找戚，反結識了陸一帆。一帆可憐江霞欲與之結婚但被拒絕。大偉以優異成績畢業，被編派與戚幹同一警署工作，江霞著大偉不要作弄父親，大偉感母甚是痴情。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如體內的止餓荷爾蒙出現失衡，會令飽足訊號減弱，造成「食極唔飽」的假象。如長期失衡，不僅可能導致肥胖，更會增加糖尿病、慢性炎症及心血管疾病風險。內分泌及糖尿科醫生詳述診治方法，並建議透過飲食與運動着手改善。肩袖肌腱病屬退化性疾病，常見於長期勞損或年長人士。運動治療師細說此病的症狀，並指出它與五十肩的分別。嘉賓除了帶來治療資訊外，更引領主持做防治運動。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅帶來「馬拉盞雞球」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 不少中風病人並非長者，主持洪永城走訪年輕中風康復者凱琪，她於廿八歲時曾因中風被診斷為永久傷殘，如何一步步踏上復康之路？頭痛、頭暈、心律不正，都有可能是中風先兆。神經外科醫生黃秉康亦指，必先分清缺血性或出血性中風，因二者的治療方向完全不同，還要記得口訣「談笑用兵」。心房顫動是中風的一大誘因，心臟科醫生馮永康講解新式脈衝場消融術的治療原理。有大學研發出復康機械臂幫助中風患者，永城親身一試鍛練手指關節。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚和高哲鬥單車險墮崖，高哲相救。高哲回憶起自己為何做俠盜：廿五年前高哲父母因火災喪生，後他知道是富商趙經琛為收樓刻意放火，於是以其兒子君豪的安全為要脅，令經琛覺悟成為大慈善家，他自此覺得公義要靠自己爭取。高哲送外賣到會，遇上江揚及一班歡送他的同事，大海宣布江揚很快就可以回歸重案組。英杰想賣血鑽給君豪，要求蓉蓉陪波子去珠海動物園，想利用她偷運血鑽；英杰送蓉蓉回家，高哲問長問短，蓉蓉對他的用意起疑。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#123粵
programme.desc: 藥房自搬新舖後生意額大升，眾人被迫來幫忙。慶卻一於少理，四出遊玩，留信要溢及義到長洲去探三妗婆。惡女搶去溢滿與有義的月餅，他們卻發現惡女是三妗婆女兒蘇花，蘇花當眾欺負三妗婆，激得溢滿接三妗婆回家暫住。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 除夕夜，鼎爺炮製足以令人飽肚的「裹蒸糉」，選葉選料都特別有要求，還要好好學習如何紮糭，以及預備整天為五花腩醃味。吃過糭，阿譚憶起端午節到順德古朗村跟村民一起包糉，並參與起龍儀式與千人龍船飯的熱鬧情況！香港地方細，絕少本土走地雞，但仍有自家培養雞種。鼎爺分享揀靚雞秘訣之餘，還切好薑絲、蔥絲，做出一碟「蔥油少爺雞」，甚麼方法可令雞皮更爽脆？鼎爺再煮一道「麻婆豆腐」滿足阿譚的食慾，但桌面竟見脢頭牛肉？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 除了龍舟競渡，不少與端午節有關的儀式習俗亦被列入非物質文化遺產之中。造船師傅羅土允有豐富的製作龍舟經驗，當中製作船頭船尾最為困難，難在哪裏？為祈求賽事順利，傳統於農曆五月初一凌晨要為龍舟進行開光及下水儀式，但龍舟沒法屈膝，它如何向神明叩拜？龍舟競渡是最廣為人知的傳統習俗，但「遊夜龍」又是甚麼？節目隨鍾氏頴川堂宗親會參加鮮為人知的遊夜龍，原來簡單如清潔神像、請神等，時間亦不由人決定！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 順德「姑婆屋」原來大有來頭，媽姐過往被戲稱「土鯪魚」，因為「骨多又惡啃」？且聽廖Sir細說早年自梳風氣。明星謝賢曾於粵語片飾演飛機欖小販，廣州現時的「雞公欖達人」可會同樣俊俏不凡？「麻甩佬」形容市井男人，但麻甩一詞竟是來自浪漫法國？「坐冷板凳」、「拍床拍蓆」意境生動，實則隱喻昔日塘西「阿姑」的坎坷生活。「土魷」、「豬膶」說法講求意頭，化身侍應的蕭博士還會鬼馬解讀「咕嚕肉」、「啫啫雞」的菜名由來。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 路過城隍廟要求好籤，位於廣州的都城隍廟不但歷史悠久，背景又如何巴閉？「水鬼升城隍」形容小人得志，廖Sir卻帶來「好人有好報」的講法，並化身「解籤佬」細說靈籤解讀方法。傳統婚禮習俗多，「戥穿石」竟然真有其石！新潮大妗姐示範新娘上頭步驟；還有史學專家施志明道出拜七姐求姻緣的典故。智堅、美恩來到佛山「揮春街」擺檔寫揮春，期間卻錯解諺語，貽笑大方。今集亦百無禁忌，大談「冬瓜豆腐」、「賣鹹鴨蛋」的俗語由來。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: Kidaverse Roblox Rumble - Kidaverse Roblox Rumble Ep7 - EP7
programme.desc: Eight kid gamers, ages eight to twelve, battle it out in ten different Roblox games to win prizes and find out who is the ultimate gamer! Video gamer, football star, and children’s book author Rashad Jennings hosts!

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Love - EP120
programme.desc: In this episode, we will learn about the value of love. We will understand that when we have love in our hearts, we care about the well-being of others, so we make them happy. Pets must also be treated with love and respect. The first step to accepting that we are unique is by loving ourselves. Respect is a big part of love and when love is in our heart, there is no place for negative feelings.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Generosity and Friendship - EP105
programme.desc: In this new episode of Kids' Planet, Nova will invite the children on a new expedition towards friendship. Together, they will learn about loyalty, respect and understanding. Curious will help us to know how generous people behave, discover empathy, and something very important: how to share with people who need it.

programme.title: Mellodees - Deck The Halls - EP19
programme.desc: It’s that time of year again! Grab some hot chocolate and your best dancing shoes to help Dee decorate the house!

programme.title: Sunny Bunnies: Get Busy - Sunny Bunnies: Get Busy Ep14 - EP114
programme.desc: In a new spin-off series of mini-episodes - ‘Sunny Bunnies Get Busy’ - the characters are on hand to entertain and engage viewers in various colourful and creative activities and inspire children to 'Get Busy'.

programme.title: Giselle and the Green Team - The Case of the Lawless Loggers - EP103
programme.desc: Gisele and the Green team once again fight Nick slick as he tries to clear cut a forest.

programme.title: Shaq's Garage - Attack of the 50 Foot Shaq - EP116
programme.desc: Shaq's friend, Keb, makes Shaq a special gift that's larger than life.

programme.title: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Burpin’ Babies Backpack Payback - EP118
programme.desc: Kent’s youth serum works a little too well and turns the gang into screaming babies. The serum soon wears off – sort of – now they’re adults trapped in baby bodies and Von Bolt doesn’t know whether to obey or burp them. When the Anti-Matters steal JD's backpack and discover the portable ALVA, they unwittingly cause Edison's hologram to disappear. The Secret Lab Kids must concoct a plan to retrieve the backpack before Edison's lost forever.

programme.title: Mellodees - We Wish You a Merry Christmas - EP21
programme.desc: It’s time to open presents with Dee and friends! Who’s next

programme.title: Casper the Friendly Ghost - Casper the Friendly Ghost Ep4 - EP104
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Asia S01 - The Arid Heart
programme.desc: In the heart of Asia lie vast arid lands. These deserts and dry grasslands are so hostile, they push life to the limit. Here, one of the rarest animals on earth, the Gobi Bear, searches desperately for water and bizarre looking long-eared Jerboas use their striking features to catch prey. On the arid grasslands, Pallas Cats need ingenious ways to get close to their prey, Mongolian Gazelles must battle harsh winters and human barriers, and Takhi are terrorised each night by Mongolian wolves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. programme.desc: Bluey's having fun copying everything Dad says and does, but the game takes a serious turn when Bluey finds a hurt budgie and they have to make an emergency trip to the vet.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Sleepover
programme.desc: A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Early Baby
programme.desc: Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they both find that their games actually have a lot in common.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Grey Headed Albatross
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Bird Island in Antarctica to help rescue a grey-headed albatross chick that gets blown off its nest during a storm.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Humboldt Penguins
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout blast off on a global adventure to Peru, South America, to uncover the stinky secret of a colony of Humboldt penguins living in the desert. Along the way, Andy encounters some boisterous sea lions and tries a bit of crowd surfing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal…

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: After a royal coup, two princes are separated, one raised in Shaolin as Dao Xing, the other as Wu Zi Tai under a minister. Years later, they meet at Shaolin while seeking the Yi Jin Jing, unaware they are brothers, as hidden identities and destiny unfold amid rising conflict and danger.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Arsenal (MW03) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Liverpool are winless in six Premier League matches against Arsenal (D4 L2), their longest winless run against the Gunners since going eight without a win between October 2007 and April 2011.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Manchester United (MW04) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United (D1 L2), though they failed to win either game (D1 L1) last season for the first time since 2020-21.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool (MW07) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: After their 3-1 win in May, Chelsea could enjoy back-to-back league wins over Liverpool for the first time since November 2014 (3 in a row).

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Manchester United (MW11) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: The 34th season of the Premier League sees Liverpool defend its title against a host of teams keen for glory themselves. 20 teams are in the mix but only 1 champion will emerge ultimately.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Manchester City (MW05) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Arsenal have won two of their last four league meetings with Manchester City (D2), as many as their previous 22 beforehand (D5 L15). The Gunners could win back-to-back league games against the Citizens for the first time since December 2015.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United (MW08) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United are winless in their last eight Premier League away games (D2 L6) since beating Leicester City 3-0 in March. The Red Devils last went longer without a league win on the road in September 1989 under Alex Ferguson (11).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Liverpool (MW11) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Liverpool won this exact fixture 2-0 last season but haven’t won consecutive away league games against Man City since a run of three between 1987 and 1991.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Patrick's Tantrum
programme.desc: Patrick goes into a destructive fit whenever he hears a bell, so his friends help him in their own ways.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Jack the Clipper

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Flabber Gassed

programme.title: The Loud House S9 - Gags To Riches Sole Searching

programme.desc: To avoid his responsibilities, Lincoln uses Lisa's hologram device to make it appear like he's doing all of his tasks. With Mom busy at work, the Loud siblings are tasked with taking care of Dad when he overreacts to getting a cold.

programme.title: The Loud House S7 - Love Me Tenor
programme.desc: When Lincoln and friends discover Gus has a hidden talent, they work together to help him live out his dream.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Swimming Fools The Goobfather
programme.desc: SpongeBob builds a pool in his backyard and Squidward tries to resist taking a dip. Mr. Krabs must reckon with the Goobfather after he adds "Patty Whips" to the menu at the Krusty Krab.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - SquidBird Allergy Attack!
programme.desc: Squidward gets left with a mess when SpongeBob and Patrick use carrier clams to send messages to each other. After cooking his kazillionth Krabby Patty, SpongeBob believes he's developed an allergy to them.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Ride Patrick Ride
programme.desc: SpongeBob teaches Patrick how to ride a bike.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 - Stan's showtime The Truth is Out There

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 - Howling Hope Mar-Smoothie-Lami
programme.desc: Hope makes lots of noise whilst skateboarding, and her howls are heard around the city causing lots of drama. The Twins manage the Smoothie Bar and the Marsups end up creating the best smoothie ever.

programme.title: The Loud House S5 - Hurl, Interrupted Diamonds are for Never
programme.desc: Lynn tries to stall her friends from riding the new coaster at Dairyland before they find out her big secret. After Lola and Mr. Grouse find a precious gem, the two struggle to decide who gets to watch over it.

programme.title: The Loud House S5 - Director's Rut Friday Night Fights

programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: Brother's Keeper II - EP33
programme.desc: Overcoming adversity, LAW WAI-SHUN (Edwin Siu) and YIU MAN-YING (Kristal Tin) successfully develop the business of Lo Son Kei and make it famous in both Hong Kong and Macau. However, their success upsets a junket promoter-turned-land developer, KO TIN-TSAU (Hugo Ng), who keeps suppressing them. WAI-SHUN is even betrayed by his close confidant TSU CHI-LIK (Mat Yeung).

programme.title: Country Spirit - EP17
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: The Driving Power - EP13
programme.desc: MUI (CHENG SIU CHOW, ADAM) is a middle-aged man who has never had a proper job. Throughout his life, he has been relying on his family and living like a playboy. His biggest achievements are marrying a singer, YUNG (YIP TUNG, CECILIA) and raising their daughter CHU (YE MICHELLE). MUI and YUNG love each other very much even after being married for more than 20 years. However, deep down, MUI is still a playboy.

programme.title: Communion - EP1
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels.

programme.title: Colourful Life - EP19
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape. The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA).

programme.title: AI Romantic - EP28
programme.desc: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires.
